name: Post-Matric Scholarship
benefit: Financial aid up to ₹1,20,000/year for higher studies
description: College aur higher education students ke tuition fees aur living expenses ke liye scholarship sahayata.
steps: National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) par OTR (One Time Registration) karein.
Aadhaar e-KYC complete karein aur apna college / course select karein.
Income certificate aur fee receipts upload karke submit karein.
College verification ke baad scholarship sidhe aapke DBT bank account mein aayegi.

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
benefit: ₹6,000 per year direct cash transfer in 3 installments
description: Desh ke sabhi kisan parivaron ko aarthik sahayata pradan karne ke liye kendra sarkar ki yojana.
documents: Active Bank Account with Aadhaar Seeded
steps: PM-Kisan official portal (pmkisan.gov.in) par 'New Farmer Registration' open karein.
Apna Aadhaar number, state aur mobile number enter karein.
Apni zameen ki khatauni aur bank details dalkar submit karein.
Aadhaar OTP se e-KYC complete karein aur har 4 mahine mein ₹2,000 ki kist prapt karein.

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor Loan)
benefit: Collateral-free working capital loan up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy
description: Street vendors, thela chalane wale aur chhote dukaandaro ke liye aasan working capital loan yojana.
documents: Vending Certificate / Identity Card (Nagar Nigam / ULB)
steps: PM SVANidhi portal open karein ya nazdiki Common Service Centre (CSC) jayein.
Apna Aadhaar linked mobile number verify karein.
Pehle phase mein ₹10,000 ka initial working capital loan apply karein.
Samay par repayment karne par agla loan ₹20,000 aur phir ₹50,000 tak milta hai saath hi cashback bhi milta hai.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
benefit: Collateral-free business loan from ₹50,000 up to ₹10,00,000
description: Naye aur existing non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises ko shuru ya badhane ke liye business loan.
steps: Apne business plan ke hisab se category chunein: Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishore (₹50k-₹5L), ya Tarun (₹5L-₹10L).
Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) par online apply karein ya kisi bhi nationalized bank/NBFC jayein.
Business proposal aur KYC documents submit karein.
Bank dwara verification ke baad seedhe loan account mein rashi disburse ki jaati hai.

name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
benefit: Free cashless treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per year per family
description: Desh ke 50 crore se adhik nagrikon ke liye muft ilaj aur hospital admission ki health insurance yojana.
documents: Active Mobile Number linked with Aadhaar
steps: PM-JAY beneficiary portal (beneficiary.nha.gov.in) par eligibility check karein.
Nazdiki sarkari hospital ya empanelled private hospital ke Ayushman Mitra counter par jayein.
Aadhaar e-KYC complete karke apna Ayushman Card download karein.
Kisi bhi list shuda hospital mein ₹5 Lakh tak ka cashless ilaj karwayen.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
benefit: Financial assistance & interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 Lakhs for building a house
description: Kachhe makan mein rehne wale sabhi parivaron ko pucca makan banane ke liye aarthik sahayata pradan karna.
documents: Proof of Land / Kutcha House Photo
steps: PMAY official portal (pmaymis.gov.in) ya Gram Panchayat office mein apply karein.
Family income aur existing kachhe ghar ki geo-tagged photos submit karein.
Gram Sabha aur District administration dwara physical inspection complete kiya jayega.
Approval ke baad foundation, roof aur finishing ke hisab se kiston mein paisa account mein aayega.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
benefit: Free toolkit worth ₹15,000 + 5% subsidized collateral-free loan up to ₹3,00,000
description: Traditional karigaron aur shilpkaron (carpenter, blacksmith, goldsmith, potter, tailor) ke samman aur unnati ke liye yojana.
steps: Nazdiki CSC center par jakar PM Vishwakarma portal par registration karwayen.
Panchayat / Nagar Palika verification ke baad Vishwakarma Certificate aur ID Card prapt karein.
5 se 7 din ki basic skill training lein jisme har roz ₹500 stipend milta hai.
₹15,000 ka toolkit voucher aur 5% sasti byaj dar par pehli kist ₹1,00,000 loan prapt karein.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
benefit: Highest government interest rate (8.2%) with full tax exemption (EEE)
description: Beti ki padhai aur shadi ke sunahare bhavishya ke liye surakshit aur aakarshak byaj wali bachat yojana.
steps: Kisi bhi nazdiki Post Office ya authorized commercial bank branch jayein.
Sukanya Samriddhi account opening form bharein.
Beti ka birth certificate aur parents ke KYC documents ke saath minimum ₹250 jama karein.
Saal mein ₹250 se ₹1.5 Lakh tak deposit karein aur beti ke 18/21 saal hone par puri rashi payen.

name: Free Smartphone & Tablet Yojana (DigiShakti Scheme)
benefit: Free Tablet / Smartphone for students + Preloaded educational content & digital skills access
description: Graduation, Post-Graduation, Diploma, ITI, Polytechnic aur higher education ke chhatron ko muft tablet aur smartphone vitran yojana jisse ve digital padhai aur competitive exams ki taiyari kar sakein.
documents: Current Year Admission Slip / Fee Receipt
Previous Year Marksheets (10th, 12th or Last Semester)
Active Mobile Number linked with Aadhaar
steps: Aapke affiliated college ya university dwara eligible chhatron ka data sidhe DigiShakti portal (digishakti.up.gov.in) par upload aur verify kiya jata hai.
Chhatra DigiShakti portal par 'Know Your Status' option mein jakar apna University/Board aur Enrollment Number enter karke status check kar sakte hain.
Data verify hone par aapke registered mobile number par SMS aayega jisme vitran ki date aur college/nodal centre ki jankari hogi.
Nirdharit tithi par apne college campus mein aayojit samaroh mein biometric / ID verification ke baad apna muft tablet/smartphone prapt karein.
